summary: A non-linear downtime session followed by a two-day festival and next-morning departure. Relative order is much stronger than civil dates.
issues: Transcript order is not chronological: initiation appears before earlier mirror conversations.
No spoken civil date independently confirms June 9 or June 20. Do not date opening initiation as June 9 simply because it appears first.
Feast of Bhishma reference note has an unresolved June 17/18 calendar conflict; its date is not used as an independent anchor.
Dream and mirror locations are retained as observations, excluded from physical travel.

duration.description: few days until main festival morning; exact position of mirror scene unknown

yamlAudit.explanation: Initiation evening → festival day 1 → festival day 2 → departure establishes three calendar boundaries. Earlier downtime adds an unspecified span. The retrospective week/ten-day description cannot independently establish the YAML start or be summed with later flashbacks. June 9–20 is not disproved, but eleven nights are not independently confirmed.
yamlAudit.conditionalCalendar: If the YAML departure date June 20 is accepted, festival days are June 18–19 and initiation is June 17. This is a projection from drEnd, not validation of drEnd.
